NER.note: Document names no central bank mandate, licensing, switch or regional link for Niger (BCEAO appears only as a statistics source).
Document mentions regulation and data protection risks only in general terms; no rules, complaints body or enforcement stated.
Document says nothing on cross-border digital payments.
Document names data protection only as a risk area; no law or authority stated.
Document says nothing on government payments to people.
Only a count of mobile money accounts is given, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The BCEAO 2024 financial inclusion dashboard, cited by the PVI coordinator, counts 9,746,822 mobile money accounts created in Niger, 4.53% of them active, and 530,557 person-to-person transfer transactions.

NER.note: Document says nothing on electronic payment of taxes or fees.
